newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm, gasoline gains $9.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, gasoline gains $9.

text.p: NWE oil products rose across the board on Thursday, traders said.
Gasoline spiked up $9 a tonne with eurograde barges traded at $227 and $229 fob.
Some dealers said problems at a U.S. cat cracker and a transatlantic draw had pushed prices higher, but others said the thin NWE market was price volatile and prey to manipulation.
Gas oil firmed $3.75 a tonne in line with September IPE futures, which were $173.75 at 1200 GMT. Heating oil barges moved early on at September IPE flat to -25 fob ARA, unchanged.
